name: GDN contribution validation
research_question: Does GDN add unique candidate value beyond the other frozen discovery arms?
comparison: GDN versus META and STAT under one preregistered candidate policy
current_evidence: Implementation and pilot candidate evidence exist but unique contribution is untested
limitations: No isolated ablation currently establishes unique benefit
next_action: Design and preregister an expanded contribution comparison
claim_impact: No GDN unique-contribution claim is ready

name: Rule-only utility
research_question: Can verified rules operate as a useful anomaly alarm arm?
comparison: D1 rule-only pilot against its preregistered utility policy
current_evidence: Frozen audited INNER rule-only evidence exists
primary_metrics: Attack-event recall and normal false-alarm episodes per hour
limitations: High normal false-fire prevents an operational-utility claim
next_action: Expand evaluation only after a new preregistration

name: Detector plus Rule fusion utility
research_question: Does combining D0 and D1 improve detector utility?
comparison: Frozen D2 policies versus the frozen D0 baseline
current_evidence: The audited pilot did not support detector improvement
result_scope: Single INNER pilot with no held-out result
primary_metrics: Incremental event recovery and normal false-alarm episodes per hour
limitations: Current policies do not establish improvement or generalization
next_action: Do not iterate from pilot outcomes without a new preregistration
claim_impact: Detector-plus-Rule improvement is not supported by the current pilot
